answers.reason: As a faculty head who represents the faculty towards the university leadership, the dean takes part in the central senate.
The budget planning round allocates funds to faculties, and the dean represents the faculty towards the central leadership.
The dean leads the faculty and holds a higher office, permitting participation in all bodies within the faculty.
The description explicitly states that the dean chairs the faculty council.
The study commission advises the faculty council, and the dean may take part in all bodies below the faculty leadership level.
The examination board is a faculty-level body, and the dean's higher office allows participation in bodies below their level.

Holders of a higher office may take part in all working groups and bodies below their level within the faculty.
